title: G3a strict evaluation contract frozen
summary: Implementation commit 6ca84cf7 freezes the exact three-seed G3a correctness criteria and the accepted future strength thresholds. Eighty-three focused edge-case tests, the 286-test full suite, Ruff, 10 independent contract mutations and 17 independent evidence-failure branches passed or failed closed as expected. PPO was not implemented at this historical milestone and training remained unauthorized.

title: Local recurrent PPO correctness micro-qualification passed
summary: Commits 68407689 and cae42da implement and provenance-harden project-native compound-action PPO replay, GAE, recurrent slicing, restricted atomic checkpoint recovery and three versioned toy tasks. Three completed candidate experiments selected the 1,024-choice lr=0.005 configuration; all three declared seeds scored 1.0 on bandit, recurrent and variable-option/multi-select tasks, stateless controls remained 0.5, recurrent margins were 0.5, replay errors and zero-tolerance counters were zero, and an independent recalculation passed. The authoritative dashboard-valid report came from a clean isolated checkout, used CPU only with two threads and zero CABT games, and does not close G3a or authorize cloud training.
